paragraphs.text: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God which hath been given in the churches of Macedonia;
paragraphs.original: Γνωρίζομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν δεδομένην ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Μακεδονίας,
paragraphs.translit: Gnōrizomen de hymin, adelphoi, tēn charin tou theou tēn dedomenēn en tais ekklēsiais tēs Makedonias,

paragraphs.text: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ἐν πολλῇ δοκιμῇ θλίψεως ἡ περισσεία τῆς χαρᾶς αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία αὐτῶν ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς ἁπλότητος αὐτῶν·
paragraphs.translit: hoti en pollē dokimē thlipseōs hē perisseia tēs charas autōn kai hē kata bathous ptōcheia autōn eperisseusen eis to ploutos tēs haplotētos autōn·

paragraphs.text: For according to their power, I bear witness, yea and beyond their power, [they gave] of their own accord,
paragraphs.original: ὅτι κατὰ δύναμιν, μαρτυρῶ, καὶ παρὰ δύναμιν, αὐθαίρετοι
paragraphs.translit: hoti kata dynamin, martyrō, kai para dynamin, authairetoi

paragraphs.text: beseeching us with much entreaty in regard of this grace and the fellowship in the ministering to the saints:
paragraphs.original: μετὰ πολλῆς παρακλήσεως δεόμενοι ἡμῶν, τὴν χάριν καὶ τὴν κοινωνίαν τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους—
paragraphs.translit: meta pollēs paraklēseōs deomenoi hēmōn, tēn charin kai tēn koinōnian tēs diakonias tēs eis tous hagious—

paragraphs.text: and [this], not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐ καθὼς ἠλπίσαμεν ἀλλʼ ἑαυτοὺς ἔδωκαν πρῶτον τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: kai ou kathōs ēlpisamen allʼ heautous edōkan prōton tō kyriō kai hēmin dia thelēmatos theou,

paragraphs.text: Insomuch that we exhorted Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace also.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τὸ παρακαλέσαι ἡμᾶς Τίτον ἵνα καθὼς προενήρξατο οὕτως καὶ ἐπιτελέσῃ εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν χάριν ταύτην·
paragraphs.translit: eis to parakalesai hēmas Titon hina kathōs proenērxato houtōs kai epitelesē eis hymas kai tēn charin tautēn·

paragraphs.text: But as ye abound in everything, [in] faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and [in] all earnestness, and [in] your love to us, [see] that ye abound in this grace also.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ὥσπερ ἐν παντὶ περισσεύετε, πίστει καὶ λόγῳ καὶ γνώσει καὶ πάσῃ σπουδῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐν ὑμῖν ἀγάπῃ, ἵνα καὶ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ χάριτι περισσεύητε.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ hōsper en panti perisseuete, pistei kai logō kai gnōsei kai pasē spoudē kai tē ex hēmōn en hymin agapē, hina kai en tautē tē chariti perisseuēte.

paragraphs.text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
paragraphs.original: Οὐ κατʼ ἐπιταγὴν λέγω ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἑτέρων σπουδῆς καὶ τὸ τῆς ὑμετέρας ἀγάπης γνήσιον δοκιμάζων·
paragraphs.translit: Ou katʼ epitagēn legō alla dia tēs heterōn spoudēs kai to tēs hymeteras agapēs gnēsion dokimazōn·

paragraphs.text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might become rich.
paragraphs.original: γινώσκετε γὰρ τὴν χάριν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅτι διʼ ὑμᾶς ἐπτώχευσεν πλούσιος ὤν, ἵνα ὑμεῖς τῇ ἐκείνου πτωχείᾳ πλουτήσητε.
paragraphs.translit: ginōskete gar tēn charin tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou, hoti diʼ hymas eptōcheusen plousios ōn, hina hymeis tē ekeinou ptōcheia ploutēsēte.

paragraphs.text: And herein I give [my] judgment: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to make a beginning a year ago, not only to do, but also to will.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γνώμην ἐν τούτῳ δίδωμι· τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν συμφέρει, οἵτινες οὐ μόνον τὸ ποιῆσαι ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ θέλειν προενήρξασθε ἀπὸ πέρυσι·
paragraphs.translit: kai gnōmēn en toutō didōmi· touto gar hymin sympherei, hoitines ou monon to poiēsai alla kai to thelein proenērxasthe apo perysi·

paragraphs.text: But now complete the doing also; that as [there was] the readiness to will, so [there may be] the completion also out of your ability.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ καὶ τὸ ποιῆσαι ἐπιτελέσατε, ὅπως καθάπερ ἡ προθυμία τοῦ θέλειν οὕτως καὶ τὸ ἐπιτελέσαι ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de kai to poiēsai epitelesate, hopōs kathaper hē prothymia tou thelein houtōs kai to epitelesai ek tou echein.

paragraphs.text: For if the readiness is there, [it is] acceptable according as [a man] hath, not according as [he] hath not.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ ἡ προθυμία πρόκειται, καθὸ ἐὰν ἔχῃ εὐπρόσδεκτος, οὐ καθὸ οὐκ ἔχει.
paragraphs.translit: ei gar hē prothymia prokeitai, katho ean echē euprosdektos, ou katho ouk echei.

paragraphs.text: For [I say] not [this] that others may be eased [and] ye distressed;
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἵνα ἄλλοις ἄνεσις, ὑμῖν θλῖψις· ἀλλʼ ἐξ ἰσότητος
paragraphs.translit: ou gar hina allois anesis, hymin thlipsis· allʼ ex isotētos

paragraphs.text: but by equality: your abundance [being a supply] at this present time for their want, that their abundance also may become [a supply] for your want; that there may be equality:
paragraphs.original: ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ τὸ ὑμῶν περίσσευμα εἰς τὸ ἐκείνων ὑστέρημα, ἵνα καὶ τὸ ἐκείνων περίσσευμα γένηται εἰς τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα, ὅπως γένηται ἰσότης·
paragraphs.translit: en tō nyn kairō to hymōn perisseuma eis to ekeinōn hysterēma, hina kai to ekeinōn perisseuma genētai eis to hymōn hysterēma, hopōs genētai isotēs·

paragraphs.text: as it is written, He that [gathered] much had nothing over; and he that [gathered] little had no lack.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς γέγραπται· Ὁ τὸ πολὺ οὐκ ἐπλεόνασεν, καὶ ὁ τὸ ὀλίγον οὐκ ἠλαττόνησεν.
paragraphs.translit: kathōs gegraptai· Ho to poly ouk epleonasen, kai ho to oligon ouk ēlattonēsen.

paragraphs.text: But thanks be to God, who putteth the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
paragraphs.original: Χάρις δὲ τῷ θεῷ τῷ διδόντι τὴν αὐτὴν σπουδὴν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ Τίτου,
paragraphs.translit: Charis de tō theō tō didonti tēn autēn spoudēn hyper hymōn en tē kardia Titou,

paragraphs.text: For he accepted indeed our exhortation; but being himself very earnest, he went forth unto you of his own accord.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι τὴν μὲν παράκλησιν ἐδέξατο, σπουδαιότερος δὲ ὑπάρχων αὐθαίρετος ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: hoti tēn men paraklēsin edexato, spoudaioteros de hyparchōn authairetos exēlthen pros hymas.

paragraphs.text: And we have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the gospel [is spread] through all the churches;
paragraphs.original: συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ μετʼ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ διὰ πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν—
paragraphs.translit: synepempsamen de metʼ autou ton adelphon hou ho epainos en tō euangeliō dia pasōn tōn ekklēsiōn—

paragraphs.text: and not only so, but who was also appointed by the churches to travel with us in [the matter of] this grace, which is ministered by us to the glory of the Lord, and [to show] our readiness:
paragraphs.original: οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀλλὰ καὶ χειροτονηθεὶς ὑπὸ τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν συνέκδημος ἡμῶν σὺν τῇ χάριτι ταύτῃ τῇ διακονουμένῃ ὑφʼ ἡμῶν πρὸς τὴν αὐτοῦ τοῦ κυρίου δόξαν καὶ προθυμίαν ἡμῶν—
paragraphs.translit: ou monon de alla kai cheirotonētheis hypo tōn ekklēsiōn synekdēmos hēmōn syn tē chariti tautē tē diakonoumenē hyphʼ hēmōn pros tēn autou tou kyriou doxan kai prothymian hēmōn—

paragraphs.text: Avoiding this, that any man should blame us in [the matter of] this bounty which is ministered by us:
paragraphs.original: στελλόμενοι τοῦτο μή τις ἡμᾶς μωμήσηται ἐν τῇ ἁδρότητι ταύτῃ τῇ διακονουμένῃ ὑφʼ ἡμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: stellomenoi touto mē tis hēmas mōmēsētai en tē hadrotēti tautē tē diakonoumenē hyphʼ hēmōn,

paragraphs.text: for we take thought for things honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
paragraphs.original: προνοοῦμεν γὰρ καλὰ οὐ μόνον ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐνώπιον ἀνθρώπων.
paragraphs.translit: pronooumen gar kala ou monon enōpion kyriou alla kai enōpion anthrōpōn.

paragraphs.text: and we have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which [he hath] in you.
paragraphs.original: συνεπέμψαμεν δὲ αὐτοῖς τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν ὃν ἐδοκιμάσαμεν ἐν πολλοῖς πολλάκις σπουδαῖον ὄντα, νυνὶ δὲ πολὺ σπουδαιότερον πεποιθήσει πολλῇ τῇ εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: synepempsamen de autois ton adelphon hēmōn hon edokimasamen en pollois pollakis spoudaion onta, nyni de poly spoudaioteron pepoithēsei pollē tē eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: Whether [any inquire] about Titus, [he is] my partner and [my] fellow-worker to you-ward, or our brethren, [they are] the messengers of the churches, [they are] the glory of Christ.
paragraphs.original: εἴτε ὑπὲρ Τίτου, κοινωνὸς ἐμὸς καὶ εἰς ὑμᾶς συνεργός· εἴτε ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν, ἀπόστολοι ἐκκλησιῶν, δόξα Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: eite hyper Titou, koinōnos emos kai eis hymas synergos· eite adelphoi hēmōn, apostoloi ekklēsiōn, doxa Christou.

paragraphs.text: Show ye therefore unto them in the face of the churches the proof of your love, and of our glorying on your behalf.
paragraphs.original: τὴν οὖν ἔνδειξιν τῆς ἀγάπης ὑμῶν καὶ ἡμῶν καυχήσεως ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν εἰς αὐτοὺς ἐνδεικνύμενοι εἰς πρόσωπον τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν.
paragraphs.translit: tēn oun endeixin tēs agapēs hymōn kai hēmōn kauchēseōs hyper hymōn eis autous endeiknymenoi eis prosōpon tōn ekklēsiōn.
